map.由市值、债务与现金求企业价值: Compute enterprise value from market cap, debt and cash
map.输入股票市值、总债务与现金及等价物，求企业价值。: Enter the stock market cap, total debt and cash & equivalents to compute enterprise value.
map.📖 查看「由市值、债务与现金求企业价值 使用指南」: 📖 View the "Compute enterprise value from market cap, debt and cash User Guide"
map.EV 反映整体收购成本。: EV reflects the total acquisition cost.
map.EV = 市值 + 总债务 − 现金，衡量整体收购代价。: EV = Market Cap + Total Debt - Cash; measures the total cost to acquire the whole firm.
map.比较不同杠杆水平的同业公司。: Compare peer companies at different leverage levels.
map.市值 50 亿、债 5 亿、现金 20 亿：EV=50+5−20=35 亿。现金: Market cap 5B, debt 0.5B, cash 2B: EV = 50 + 5 - 20 = 35 (100M). High cash markedly lowers EV.
map.收购方接手公司同时获得现金，相当于净支付减少，故从市值+债务中扣除。: The acquirer also takes over the cash, which is like a reduced net payment, so it is deducted from market cap plus debt.
map.EV 和市值区别？: What is the difference between EV and market cap?
map.市值只看股权；EV 包含债权、扣除现金，反映\"买下整个生意\"的成本，更适合跨: Market cap looks only at equity; EV includes debt and deducts cash, reflecting the cost to 'buy the whole business', and is better for cross-leverage comparison.
